EVA is a great economical bind and still provides excellent rigidity to the book. PUR is a reactive glue that hardens over 24 hours. It’s about 40% stronger than EVA, so it is typically ordered for more durable end-uses like self-published books, cook books, yearbooks, etc.\u003c/p\u003e"},{"question":"Why is PUR glue stronger than EVA?","answer":"\u003cp\u003ePUR stands for “Polyurethane Reactive.” It undergoes a chemical reaction during the curing process, allowing it form strong bonds to many different materials. PUR properties also draw moisture out of the air during the curing process, thereby creating a stronger bond than EVA.\u003c/p\u003e    \u003cp\u003ePUR glue can’t be damaged by oils used in the digital print process. It also doesn’t allow ink to migrate into the spine, which can weaken the spine over time.  As a result, PUR has better “page pull” resistance compared to EVA.\u003c/p\u003e    PUR also provides a stronger bond on high page count books."},{"question":"Why does PUR glue last longer than EVA?","answer":"\u003cp\u003eOnce cured, EVA glue can be reactivated with heat, causing it to melt. It can also become brittle and crack in extremely cold temperatures. \u003c/p\u003e    Once the bond is set, PUR glue can’t be reactivated. It doesn’t melt with heat, and it can withstand very cold temperatures without damage."},{"question":"What makes PUR glue more flexible?","answer":"\u003cp\u003ePUR binding applies a thinner coating of adhesive than EVA. This causes less distortion of the spine while giving it more flexibility and a cleaner appearance.\u003c/p\u003e"},{"question":"What are the most common uses for perfect bound books?","answer":"\u003cp\u003eBecause perfect binding is such a versatile product, we see this type of binding used for catalogs, magazines, manuals, self-published books, children’s books and much more.\u003c/p\u003e"},{"question":"How soon can I get my perfect bound books?","answer":"\u003cp\u003eYour exact delivery dates may vary depending on quantity ordered and page count, but the fastest delivery options will get your perfect bound books in your hands within 5 business days.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003ePUR binding takes an additional few days to produce and cure over a 24-hour timeframe, which is why we require more time. Because of this process, we have to print the books on a longer sheet, so that when they’re folded in half, the folded dimensions will match the final dimension.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\u003cp\u003eFor example, if you ordered an 8.5 x 11” book, we would have to print your books on an 11 x 17” sheet and fold it in half to make your 8.5 x 11” book.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\u003cp\u003eSince saddle stitch books are folded and stapled with a longer sheet, we can only increase or decrease the page count in multiples of four. If you have and odd-numbered book, we can add blank pages to accommodate your design.\u003c/p\u003e"},{"question":"What is the highest number of pages that can be used with a saddle-stitched binding?","answer":"\u003cp\u003eSaddle stitching works best for booklets with 64 pages or less. You can have more pages, but the booklet may not lie as flat as you would like. Also, higher page count booklets may require more than two staples, the number used in most saddle-stitched booklets.\u003c/p\u003e"},{"question":"Why use Printivity’s saddle stitch printing service?","answer":"\u003cp\u003eEvery order comes backed with our customer satisfaction guarantee. This results in a sturdy bind that makes it easy to turn the pages.
